features.name: Seamless infinite looping
features.headline: Loops that never end. Or click.
features.copy: Sample-accurate seamless looping. Leave it running for the whole service, the whole session, the whole night.
features.animation: circular waveform closing into infinity symbol

features.name: 12 real keys per preset
features.headline: Twelve keys. Zero pitch-shifting.
features.copy: Every preset is recorded twelve times — one real performance per key. Your E♭ was never a stretched C.

features.name: Key planets UI
features.headline: Touch a planet. Change the sky.
features.copy: Keys orbit as living planets. Tap one and the pad crossfades into a new tonal world.

features.name: Preset-colored living UI
features.headline: It wears your sound's color.
features.copy: Choose a preset and the entire interface — planets, knobs, sky — re-tints to match.

features.name: FX & Texture stars
features.headline: Two stars. Endless weather.
features.copy: Rain, wind, birds, crowds, prayers — layered atmospheres that survive preset changes and fade out with the music.
features.animation: gold star pulse; rain streaks behind ice star

features.name: Room / Plate / Hall reverb
features.headline: Three rooms in one knob row.
features.copy: Room, Plate, and Hall — tuned to the classics — with Mix, Size, and Damp when you want to go deeper.

features.name: Crossfaded transitions
features.headline: Every transition is musical.
features.copy: Pads, keys, and presets crossfade smoothly — 0.5 to 12 seconds, your call.

features.name: Standalone + VST3
features.headline: Stage app. Studio plugin. Same soul.
features.copy: Run it standalone before the set or load the VST3 in your DAW.

features.name: Folder-based preset packs
features.headline: New sounds, no reinstall.
features.copy: Preset packs drop in as folders. The app just sees them.
features.animation: folder opening, pads flying to stage
